query:
SELECT bel.id, bel.bibliography_id, bel.entity_type, bel.entity_id, bel.link_type, bel.notes
FROM bibliography_entity_links bel
WHERE bel.bibliography_id IN (30001, 30002)
ORDER BY bel.bibliography_id, bel.entity_type;
